meta.title: Checkpoint review notes
meta.description: Turns a pending delivery review into one annotatable sheet in the right sidebar: highlight any passage of the deliverable, comment on each decision point, and send the notes back to the agent as structured JSON. While enabled it also takes over any ask_user_question that carries 3 or more questions, so a long confirmation is answered on one screen instead of one card per question; single-question prompts keep the native card. Web client only. Nothing is sent anywhere: notes travel through the local session, and drafts live in this browser's session storage.
